tabs.html:
MikroTik RB4011iGS+RM | High-Performance 10G Router with IPsec Acceleration

Powerful & Affordable Networking Solution

The MikroTik RB4011iGS+RM is an amazingly powerful, cost-effective router designed for high-speed networking. Equipped with ten Gigabit Ethernet ports, a 10Gbps SFP+ interface, and IPsec hardware acceleration, this compact yet robust router is perfect for enterprise networks, data centers, and advanced home setups.


Quad-Core Cortex A15 CPU – Same powerful CPU as the carrier-grade RB1100AHx4

10 x Gigabit Ethernet Ports – High-speed, reliable wired connectivity

1 x SFP+ 10G Port – Lightning-fast fiber optic networking

PoE Output on Port #10 – Powers other devices without additional adapters

Professional Matte Black Metal Enclosure – Durable & sleek design

Rackmount Ready – Includes rackmount ears for 1U rack installations


Key Features 

  • Blazing-Fast Performance – Quad-core ARM CPU (1.9GHz) & 1GB RAM
  • IPsec Hardware Acceleration – Secures your network with high-speed encryption
  • Enterprise-Grade Networking – Handles complex firewall rules, VLANs, & routing
  • Passive Cooling – Efficient fanless design ensures silent operation
  • Power-Efficient PoE Out – Delivers Passive PoE up to 57V on Ethernet Port 10
  • Advanced Monitoring – Includes voltage & PCB temperature sensors
  • Durable & Compact – Metal enclosure for reliability & long lifespan


Technical Specifications

  • Product Code: RB4011iGS+RM
  • Architecture: ARM 32-bit
  • CPU: AL21400 (4 Cores, Auto 533 – 1900MHz)
  • Switch Chip Model: RTL8367SB
  • RAM: 1GB
  • Storage: 512MB NAND
  • RouterOS License: Level 5
  • Operating System: RouterOS v7
  • MTBF: ~200,000 hours @ 25°C
  • Tested Ambient Temperature: -40°C to 70°C
  • IPsec Hardware Acceleration: Yes


Power & Cooling

  • Power Inputs: 2 (DC Jack & PoE-In)
  • DC Input Voltage: 12V – 57V
  • PoE Input Voltage: 18V – 57V Passive PoE
  • PoE Output (Ethernet 10): Passive PoE up to 57V
  • Max Power Consumption: 33W (18W without attachments)
  • Cooling: Passive (Fanless)


Connectivity

  • Ethernet Ports: 10 x 10/100/1000 Mbps
  • Fiber Ports: 1 x SFP+ (10Gbps)
  • Serial Console Port: RJ45

What's in the Box?

  • RB4011iGS+RM Router
  • 24V 1.5A Power Adapter
  • 4011 Rackmount Ears
  • K-60 Mounting Kit

Ideal Use Cases

  • Enterprise Networks – Secure & high-performance business networking
  • Data Centers – Reliable Gigabit & 10G fiber connectivity
  • ISPs & Service Providers – Handles advanced routing, firewall, & QoS
  • High-Performance Home Networks – Perfect for power users & smart homes
  • Wireless ISP (WISP) Applications – Passive PoE out for powering wireless devices


Why Choose the MikroTik RB4011iGS+RM?

  • High-Performance Quad-Core CPU – Delivers lightning-fast networking speeds
  • 10G Fiber Connectivity – SFP+ port for seamless high-speed transfers
  • Compact & Rackmount Ready – Professional metal enclosure with rackmount ears
  • Silent Operation – Passive cooling ensures zero noise
  • Future-Proof RouterOS v7 – Advanced routing, firewall, and VPN capabilities
